SELECT
FROM `person` p LEFT JOIN `organization` o ON p.org_id = o.id AND o.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN `person_detail` pd ON p.id = pd.person_id AND pd.deleted = 0 WHERE p.id = #{personId} AND p.deleted = 0
